text:
jamie: FYI getting pages for p99 spikes on inference streaming across US region, customers reporting stalls. Seeing sustained p95 ~ 420ms and p99 ~ 1.8s on timeline ingest.

alex: seeing the same in dashboards. tail latency spikes line up with a flurry of config fetch errors to config-store (403/429).

maria: logs show auth token store returning 503s and retries piling up. sample trace: `inference->controlplane->auth-tokenstore->configstore` heavy latency.

lee: ops-bot just created an incident: INCIDENT-3309, paging oncall. tagging @oncall.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created (INC-3309). Severity: SLO_BREACH. Annotated metrics: p95=420ms, p99=1790ms, streaming stalls +12% over baseline.

oncall: I'm up. quick ask: is customer impact widespread or a subset? any big customers hit?

jamie: partial: high QPS tenants on hosted API and a couple dedicated pools see elevated retries. not all customers. support reported 3 customer tickets (one paid enterprise).

alex: stack traces point to a spike of `403 rate_limit` from the config-service when fetching feature flags + per-tenant routing. looks like a hotkey on config fetch for a featureflag.

maria: confirmed: one tenant started aggressive polling after a release, featureflag key `ff/experiment-22` is hot. configstore throttling, which triggers auth token refresh path heavily.

lee: mitigation proposal: 1) throttle that tenant at API gateway (rate-limit override) 2) enable configstore short-circuit cache for flag reads 3) fallback routing to default model variant for streaming to avoid per-request config lookups.

oncall: agree. I'll put a temporary rate-limit patch on the tenant (bump to 50rps hard cap). jamie can you enable the cache?

jamie: applying cache bypass -> enabling local TTL cache for flag reads (30s) in the controlplane. patch queued.

alex: I'll flip the routing fallback: if config fetch fails > 2x, use pinned-route -> model-lite (lower-latency) and skip re-checks for 15s. adding a canary header.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: controlplane cache patch started on canary host cp-canary-3.

maria: auth tokenstore still shows elevated error rate but queue length down 40% since we started rate-limiting tenant. p95 dropping to ~220ms. p99 trending down.

lee: pushing a temporary rate-limit rule to API gateway now: tenant:t-998 -> 50rps. patch applied. monitoring for errors.

oncall: Customer impact update: one enterprise tenant reported degraded streaming for 12m, now back to degraded->ok. support will follow up.

jamie: can we also add a circuit-breaker in controlplane for config fetch fanout? right now a single failing downstream cascades into retries.

alex: good call. I'll open a follow-up ticket: `CP-1234 circuit-breaker configstore fanout`. For immediate relief I'm enabling a short explicit backoff (0.2s) and collapsing concurrent duplicate fetches with inflight dedupe.

maria: metrics look better: p95 ~ 180ms, p99 ~ 620ms and streaming stalls reduced to baseline. keeping the incident open for 30m observation.

ops-bot: Incident update (INC-3309): mitigations applied: tenant rate-limit, controlplane cache TTL enabled, routing fallback active. SLO impact reduced.

lee: coordination note: we'll keep the canary cache for 2 hours, then roll to 2 more hosts after validation. also schedule a postmortem to look at featureflag polling hysteria + capacity planning for configstore.

noncall: oncall handoff at 04:00 UTC to next shift. I'll include runbook items: how to identify hot config keys, how to apply tenant rate-limits, and the quick fallback toggle for routing.

jamie: leaving a snippet for quick fallback toggle:
```
# toggle fallback route for streaming
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/route/fallback \
  -d '{"enabled":true, "duration_s":15}'
```

alex: action items captured: 1) short term: keep rate-limit + cache + fallback for 2h 2) postmortem with configstore owners + infra to add circuit-breaker + inflight dedupe 3) consider per-tenant polling detection and automated soft-throttle.

maria: support will send impacted customer comms (apology + summary + remediation steps).

lee: closing the immediate page. moving to incident monitoring mode. if p99 rises again we re-escalate.

ops-bot: Incident INC-3309 status: Monitoring. Next automated check in 15m.

jamie: thanks team. I'll file the postmortem draft and link here.

oncall: handed off. :white_check_mark:
